name: Slider
description: Numeric input with ordered thumbs and an optional independently editable crop interval.

value.description: Controlled finite number or nonempty array. Values are snapped and sorted.

defaultValue.description: Initial uncontrolled value(s), restored on reset. Defaults to min.

min.description: Finite lower bound and step origin. Defaults to 0.

max.description: Finite upper bound, at least min. Defaults to 100.

step.description: Positive finite increment. End selects the last step at or below max. Defaults to 1.

disabled.description: Disable editing and submission, including crop. Defaults to false.

orientation.description: Horizontal follows text direction; vertical increases upward. Defaults to horizontal.

label.description: Visible noninteractive name, including rich text.

aria-label.description: Name when there is no visible label, or override for it.

aria-labelledby.description: External naming elements; takes precedence over label and aria-label.

labels.description: Specific or localized names for individual controls.

showValue.description: Display the value inside each primary handle. Defaults to false.

crop.description: Enable two editable crop boundaries independently of value presentation. Defaults to false.

cropRange.description: Controlled crop boundaries, sorted and snapped to the same step grid.

defaultCropRange.description: Initial uncontrolled crop, restored on reset. Defaults to the full range.

clampToCrop.description: Constrain primary values to the accepted crop. Defaults to true.

name.description: Native form key, repeated for ordered primary values.

cropName.description: Native form key, repeated for crop start/end when crop is enabled.

form.description: External form id for all controls.

autoFocus.description: Focus the first primary thumb on mount. Defaults to false.

membrane.description: Shared spacing around handles and label. Defaults to true.

notes: Each thumb is a native range input with its own accessible name, bounds and orientation.
Use label, aria-label or aria-labelledby for the group; labels provides complete individual names.
formatValue supplies accessible value text, including units.
One native input lives inside every thumb and enabled crop part. Membrane surrounds each control without adding tab stops.
Measured control extents reserve track edges; all handles share logical track coordinates.
Hit areas remain at least 24px even when control density is smaller.
Private Slider variables describe geometry, not alternate behavior.

whenNotToUse: Few discrete options (use Radio or Select)
